tools.name: search
tools.description:
Default search for Swiss court decisions and case law on entscheidsuche.ch (Federal Supreme Court BGer/BGE and cantonal courts; German, French, Italian). Use this tool unless you need something specific.

Describe the legal question or the facts in natural language, in any language — the search works by meaning (AI embedding search, same as `semantic_search`) and also finds decisions that use different words or are written in another language. Each hit comes with the passage of the decision that best matches the query.

The tool switches to exact keyword search (same as `keyword_search`) automatically when the query is a case number or citation (e.g. '5A_396/2015', 'BGE 142 III 1'), contains a quoted phrase, Boolean operators or wildcards, is empty or '*', or when `sort`, `search_after` or `include_aggregations` is used. The response field `search_mode` says which search ran.

Read the full text of a hit with `fetch` (or `fetch_document`), passing the hit's `id`. Filters are combined with AND. Hierarchy IDs (canton / court / chamber, e.g. 'CH_BGer', 'ZH_OG') are case-sensitive; take them from `list_hierarchy` or `list_facets`.

query.title: Query

language.description: Preferred language (de, fr, it) for the displayed title and abstract. Does NOT filter — use `language_filter` for that.

include_context.title: Include Context

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description:
AI search by meaning (semantic / embedding search) across Swiss court decisions on entscheidsuche.ch. Best for legal questions, descriptions of facts and concepts: write one or more full sentences instead of keywords, e.g. 'Can a landlord terminate the lease because his daughter wants to move in?'. Works across languages: a German query also finds French and Italian decisions.

How it works: the query is compared with the passages of all decisions; the 100 best-matching passages are determined and grouped by decision. Results are ranked by similarity (`score`); `text` contains the best matching passage of each decision. There is no pagination, no other sort order and no Boolean syntax — use `keyword_search` for exact terms, `search_by_case_number` for case numbers.

Filters are combined with AND. Hierarchy IDs (canton / court / chamber, e.g. 'CH_BGer', 'ZH_OG') are case-sensitive; take them from `list_hierarchy` or `list_facets`.

tools.name: keyword_search
tools.description: Exact keyword (full-text) search across Swiss court decisions on entscheidsuche.ch. Finds decisions that contain the given words. Use it for specific terms, statute articles, names, quoted phrases, complete result lists, sorting by date and pagination. For legal questions in natural language prefer `semantic_search`. Search syntax (Lucene query string): - All terms must occur (default operator AND). - Phrase: "dringender Eigenbedarf" (double quotes). - Boolean operators in capitals between terms: AND, OR, NOT. - Wildcards: * and ? — '*' alone matches every decision. - Statute citations work as written: Art. 271 OR, Art. 8 ZGB. - Put case numbers in quotes ("5A_396/2015") or use `search_by_case_number`. If a query is not valid syntax it is searched as plain terms and the response says so in `note`. `text` contains a snippet with the matched terms in …. Filters are combined with AND. Hierarchy IDs (canton / court / chamber, e.g. 'CH_BGer', 'ZH_OG') are case-sensitive; take them from `list_hierarchy` or `list_facets`. Pagination: pass `next_cursor` of the response as `search_after` in the next call (same query, same sort).

query.description: Search terms. "..." for phrases, AND/OR/NOT for Boolean operators, * and ? for wildcards. "*" matches everything.

tools.name: fetch_document
tools.description: Fetch one Swiss court decision by its document ID and return its full text together with title, court, date and links. Use the `id` of a hit returned by one of the search tools. For very long decisions the text is capped at 100,000 characters; if `text_truncated` is true, the complete document is available at `document_url`.

id.description: Document ID of a search hit, e.g. 'CH_BGer_005_5A-396-2015_2017-06-22'.
id.title: Id

language.description: Preferred language (de, fr, it) for title and abstract.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Swiss court decision by its document ID and return its full text together with title, court, date and links. Use the `id` of a hit returned by one of the search tools. For very long decisions the text is capped at 100,000 characters; if `text_truncated` is true, the complete document is available at `document_url`. Identical to `fetch_document`.

id.description: Document ID of a search hit, e.g. 'CH_BGer_005_5A-396-2015_2017-06-22'.
id.title: Id

language.description: Preferred language (de, fr, it) for title and abstract.

tools.name: list_hierarchy
tools.description: Returns the hierarchy IDs of Swiss cantons, courts and chambers together with the number of decisions, optionally restricted to the decisions matching a keyword query. Use the IDs in the `hierarchy` filter of the search tools.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Tree of all cantons, courts and chambers with their names in German, French and Italian. The `id` fields can be used in the `hierarchy` filter of the search tools.
